en.hubeali: H 14726 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed Al-Ataar, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Umar the brother of Azaafir who said:

A person handed over to me six or seven hundred Dirhams for Abu Abdullahasws. So it was in my bag, When I arrived at Al-Hafeera, my bag had split and whatever was in it had gone. I got the officer in Al-Medina to concur with it. He said, ‘Are you the one whose bag split and your belongings were gone?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He said, ‘When you get to the city, come to us and we will compensate you’.

So when I arrived at Al-Medina, I came up to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> who<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘O Umar, your bag was split and your belongings were gone?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Given you is better than what has been taken from you. The she-camel of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> got lost, so the people said regarding it, ‘He<sup>saww</sup> informs us about the sky and he<sup>saww</sup> cannot inform us about his<sup>saww</sup> she-camel’. Jibraeel descended and said: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! Your<sup>saww</sup> she-camel is in such and such a valley. Its bridle has been entangled with such and such a tree’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he<sup>saww</sup> ascended the Pulpit. He<sup>saww</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Extolled Him<sup>azwj</sup> and said: ‘O you people! You spoke a great deal to me<sup>saww</sup> regarding my<sup>saww</sup> she-camel. Indeed! And what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Given me<sup>saww</sup> is better than what was taken from me<sup>saww</sup>. Indeed! My<sup>saww</sup> she-camel is in such a such a valley. Its bridle has been entangled with such and such a tree’. So the people rushed towards it and found her as the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> had said’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Go to the office bearer of Al-Medina and acquire from him what he has promised you, for it is something, which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Invited you to it. You never demanded it from him’.
